pr_comments:
@t8m Trying. That change is based off of 3.2, which has not compiled on NonStop because of a few year old issues. This new compile error crops up when including this change:

```
      if (aligned64(out) && aligned64(in)) {
          ^
"/home/ituglib/randall/openssl-3.0/providers/implementations/ciphers/cipher_aes_gcm_siv_polyval.c", line 49: error(114):
          identifier "uintptr_t" is undefined

      if (aligned64(out) && aligned64(in)) {
          ^
"/home/ituglib/randall/openssl-3.0/providers/implementations/ciphers/cipher_aes_gcm_siv_polyval.c", line 49: error(112):
          expected a ")"

      if (aligned64(out) && aligned64(in)) {
                            ^
"/home/ituglib/randall/openssl-3.0/providers/implementations/ciphers/cipher_aes_gcm_siv_polyval.c", line 49: error(112):
          expected a ")"
```

> @t8m Trying.

Can you please cherry-pick the commit on top of the openssl-3.1 checkout and test that instead?

Not saying we shouldn't eventually fix also the build on the master branch but that will require probably much larger effort.

> > @t8m Trying.
> 
> Can you please cherry-pick the commit on top of the openssl-3.1 checkout and test that instead?
> 
> Not saying we shouldn't eventually fix also the build on the master branch but that will require probably much larger effort.

The cherry-pick handled the compile errors. Thanks. I'm running the test suite with hope.

Here are the results:
* The compile is fine.
* 30-test_evp_extra.t fails. This was reported previously on the 3.1 (now 3.2) thread, so I am worried that something is broken here and a fix was not applied. The details of the failure are:
```
    ok 52 - test_ecx_not_private_key
../../util/wrap.pl ../../test/evp_extra_test -context => 139
```
which appears to be a `SIGSEGV`. Running with V=1 is not informative.

The above failure looks exactly like #17537, which was a prior 3.1 (before the renumbering) error that has not been fixed. This is now in the 3.1-alpha thread and is a problem with DLL unloading because of `atexit()` mis-handling.

24 hours has passed since 'approval: done' was set, but this PR has failing CI tests.  Once the tests pass it will get moved to 'approval: ready to merge' automatically, alternatively please review and set the label manually.
Merged to master and 3.1 branches. Thank you for the reviews.
